Title: LSJ: Playing Archon Investigation with less than 3 pool

Messages.Author: YY
Messages.Body:
Is a Methuselah allowed to play cards xe does not have enough pool to
pay for?

or more specifically,
Is a Methuselah allowed to play A.I. if xe has less than 3 pool left?

Thanks.

YY

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 16 Nov 2009 17:01:48 -0800 (PST), YY wrote:

>Is a Methuselah allowed to play cards xe does not have enough pool to
>pay for?

No.
You must be able to pay the cost of the card to play it.

>or more specifically,
>Is a Methuselah allowed to play A.I. if xe has less than 3 pool left?

No.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No, they match.

You cannot attempt what you cannot do.
And, for cases like Vast Weath where you find out later (after committing to the
action), then you pay as much of the cost as you can (and it fizzles for lack of
complete cost payment).

Messages.Author: YY
Messages.Body:

IIRC, the Vast Wealth ruling is based on the fact that the action
provided by Vast Wealth itself has a cost of 0 (zero). The cost of the
equipment is a side effect of resolving the action.
